name: Banner
description: `Banner` announces a page-level status or message that needs attention but does not interrupt the user. Use `Dialog` instead when the message must block the task, and inline validation for a single field.

props.name: actionsLayout
props.description: Whether actions sit inline with the message or stack below it.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting detail shown below the title.

props.name: flush
props.description: Removes the outer border and radius so the banner can span a container edge to edge.

props.name: hideTitle
props.description: Hides the title visually while keeping it available to assistive technology.

props.name: layout
props.description: Use `compact` to reduce the banner's spacing.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Replaces the icon the variant would otherwise choose.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a dismiss button and is called when it is pressed.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: Most important action, rendered first.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Supporting action, rendered after the primary one.

props.name: title
props.description: Short summary of the banner's message.

props.name: variant
props.description: Severity of the message, which also sets the colour and default icon.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: Most important action, rendered first.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Supporting action, rendered after the primary one.

props.name: alignContent
props.description: Whether the label sits centred or hugs the start edge when visuals are present.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches the button to fill the width of its container.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown in a trailing counter, for a button that acts on a known quantity.

props.name: data-component
props.description: Overrides the marker used to identify this element in tests and styling.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents activation and removes the button from the keyboard order.

props.name: inactive
props.description: Marks the button temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable, so its reason can be announced.

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: Lets a long label wrap onto more than one line instead of being clipped.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Icon shown before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses activation.

props.name: loadingAnnouncement
props.description: Text announced to assistive technology while the button is loading.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the button.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Icon shown at the far end, conventionally a chevron for a button that opens something.

props.name: trailingVisual
props.description: Icon shown after the label.
